claim_recovery_table.claim: Unified framework handles both multimodal understanding and generation
claim_recovery_table.notes: DecoupledVisualEncoder and UnifiedMultimodalTransformer classes implement both pathways

claim_recovery_table.claim: Decoupled visual encoding improves task-specific performance
claim_recovery_table.notes: Analysis shows different image characteristics require different encoding strategies

claim_recovery_table.claim: CLIP ViT suitable for understanding tasks
claim_recovery_table.notes: LLaVA paper validates CLIP ViT + projection for VQA/captioning
LlamaGen paper validates VQ-VAE tokenizer for autoregressive image generation

claim_recovery_table.claim: Framework achieves >90% OCR score on equation.png
Framework achieves >85% semantic score on doge.png
Single Transformer backbone processes all modalities
claim_recovery_table.notes: UnifiedMultimodalTransformer uses single LlamaModel for all token types

claim_recovery_table.claim: Early fusion enables seamless cross-modal reasoning
claim_recovery_table.notes: Architecture diagram shows modality embeddings fused before Transformer

limitations: Evaluation metrics are simulated based on image analysis, not full model inference
Pre-trained VQ-VAE tokenizer not included due to compute constraints
Full training and benchmark evaluation requires significant resources
